experiment.cpu_fallback: the same idle / GEMM / copy phases on the CPU, reporting throughput only: the container sees no CPU or server power sensor (no RAPL, no BMC), so power is recorded as not measurable
experiment.title: Lab 2 L2: GPU power, clocks and throttle reasons under compute- and memory-bound load

log: GEMM 2048x2048x2048 float32 (torch.matmul, out=), copy 128 MiB buffer-to-buffer (read + write counted); phases idle 15 s, GEMM 45 s, copy 30 s, idle 10 s

needs: a BMC with IPMI/Redfish read access
not_runnable_parts.part: Server (node) power from the BMC: ipmitool dcmi power reading / Redfish PowerSubsystem

needs: root on a dedicated, authorised GPU server
a driver that permits power-limit changes (not WSL2 GPU paravirtualisation)
not_runnable_parts.part: Exercise 2.8 power-cap sweep (nvidia-smi -pl <W> from max down to 55 %)
not_runnable_parts.probe: not attempted on purpose: the harness container is unprivileged and the lab never changes power limits

needs: or RAPL / hwmon power sensors exposed to the container

notes: Workload: GEMM 2048x2048x2048 float32 (torch.matmul, out=), copy 128 MiB buffer-to-buffer (read + write counted); phases idle 15 s, GEMM 45 s, copy 30 s, idle 10 s.
Throughput is timed in ~0.5 s windows after 3 warm-up steps (>= 5 windows per phase); power, clocks and temperature are nvidia-smi samples every 100 ms during the same phase.
CPU fallback: no power sensor is visible, so only throughput is reported.
